components.label: Caller
components.responsibility: Invoke the documented API and retain returned outcomes.

components.label: Ring counter
components.responsibility: Route each second to its slot word; hit loads, proposes and compare-and-swaps {round,count} without locks; getHits loads each word once; limiter-mode keys serialize tryAcquire per key.

components.label: Injected clock
components.responsibility: Use an injected clock adapter with nondecreasing clamp and a visible rollback diagnostic; never trust request time for expiration.

components.label: Packed slot words
components.responsibility: Index now modulo 300; each slot is one 64-bit atomic word packing round = floor(second/300) in the high 32 bits and count in the low 32 bits, never a bare count.

components.label: CAS slot update
components.responsibility: Load the word; if its round equals now's round propose count+1, otherwise propose {round(now),1}; compareAndSet and, on failure, reload and retry. If the word already holds a newer round, resample the clock instead of writing an older round.

components.label: Weakly consistent scan
components.responsibility: Sample now, load each of the 300 words once without locks, set snapshotTime to the maximum of now and every decoded second, then sum words whose second lies in (snapshotTime-300, snapshotTime].

components.label: Per-key admission gate
components.responsibility: A key created in limiter mode routes every mutation through tryAcquire, which holds that key's admission mutex while it scans, compares with the limit and applies one compare-and-swap increment. Counter-mode keys never take it.

components.label: Key lifecycle
components.responsibility: Use a capped key directory and reference pinning; reclaim idle keys only when their window is empty and no operation pins the entry.

components.label: Checked arithmetic
components.responsibility: Reject a hit whose slot count would exceed the 32-bit field before its compare-and-swap, and add the 300-slot sum in checked 64-bit arithmetic; report exhaustion rather than wrap.

components.label: Caller
components.responsibility: Invoke the documented API and retain returned outcomes.

components.label: Deque counter
components.responsibility: Give each key S stripes picked by calling-thread hash; each stripe owns an ascending {second,count} deque under its own mutex; getHits and tryAcquire hold all S stripes of the key in ascending order.

components.label: Key directory and thread stripes
components.responsibility: Look up the key in a bounded directory and pin the entry; pick stripe hash(threadId) mod S and hold only that stripe's mutex for the hit.

components.label: Monotone key clock
components.responsibility: Sample the injected monotone clock while holding the stripe mutex; clamp regressions and keep diagnostic state.

components.label: Timestamp buckets
components.responsibility: Increment the stripe's tail bucket if its timestamp equals now, otherwise append one bucket; keep a checked stripe total.

components.label: Head expiry
components.responsibility: Before a stripe is read or appended, pop while head.second <= now-300 and subtract each count from that stripe's total exactly once.

components.label: All-stripe decision
components.responsibility: getHits and tryAcquire lock all S stripes in ascending index order, sample now once, expire and sum the stripe totals; tryAcquire adds one hit to its own stripe before unlocking in reverse order.

components.label: Idle-key reaper
components.responsibility: After expiration leaves every stripe empty, mark idle; directory removal checks entry identity and pin count. Live-key cap rejects rather than evicts active accounting.

components.label: Cross-stripe overflow policy
components.responsibility: A hit whose stripe total would overflow is rejected before touching its deque; getHits adds stripe totals with checked 64-bit addition and reports exhaustion instead of wrapping. Reinitialization is an explicit operator action.

requirements.text: Record concurrent hits without losing increments when a ring slot changes epoch; expire at the exact 300-second boundary.
Use granular hit-path synchronization and a consistent count snapshot policy.
Inject time and define clock rollback, overflow, per-key memory bounds and optional atomic check-and-admit.

problem.scope: Authored in-process exact integer-second counter and optional admission limiter. Compare a per-key ring of 300 packed {round,count} words updated by compare-and-swap with per-key timestamp deques striped by calling thread. Count window at second now is [now-299,now]; timestamps <=now-300 expire. The injected nondecreasing clock defines time, not client timestamps. No cross-machine clock or distributed rate-limit guarantee.

evidence.testName: batch-08 counter ring: CAS slot words, resampling and weakly consistent scan

acceptanceCases.given: Hits at seconds 0, 0, 299 and 300 under injected time, and 3000 seeded hits on a second counter.
acceptanceCases.then: Counts are 3, 2, 1, 0; second 0 leaves the window exactly at 300; the read at 500 is clamped to 600 and counted as one rollback; every seeded count matches the oracle.
acceptanceCases.when: Read at 299, 300, 599, 600 and then 500, and compare every seeded read with an exact event oracle.

evidence.testName: batch-08 counter ring: CAS slot words, resampling and weakly consistent scan

acceptanceCases.given: Two hits at second 0 in slot 0; two hits at second 300 that both load the old word; and a hit sampled at second 0 after slot 0 already holds second 300.
acceptanceCases.then: The loser's compare-and-swap fails once and retries, leaving slot 0 at second 300 with count 2; the stale-sampled hit resamples and counts at 300 instead of resetting the slot to second 0.
acceptanceCases.when: Let one hit at 300 commit between the other's load and its compare-and-swap.

evidence.testName: batch-08 counter ring: CAS slot words, resampling and weakly consistent scan

acceptanceCases.when: The concurrent hit commits after the scan passes slot 50 and before it reaches slot 101.

evidence.testName: batch-08 counter ring: CAS slot words, resampling and weakly consistent scan

acceptanceCases.given: A limiter-mode key with limit 2 and one admitted request; two more admissions start together; 3000 seeded admissions on another limiter key.
acceptanceCases.then: The second waits; the first is admitted and the second then sees the limit reached and is denied without incrementing; the count is 2; a plain hit on a limiter key is rejected; seeded admissions match an exact oracle.
acceptanceCases.when: The second admission tries to take the admission mutex while the first holds it.

evidence.testName: batch-08 counter ring: CAS slot words, resampling and weakly consistent scan

acceptanceCases.given: A slot word already at count 2^32-1.

acceptanceCases.given: A key directory at its live-key cap and an idle key whose window is empty.

tradeoffs: getHits is weakly consistent: hits concurrent with the scan may or may not be counted.
